Clarity, day to night

  • Multi-day battery

    Fewer charge breaks keeps your data continuous, so trends hold up across real weeks, not perfect days.

  • Day + night tracking

    See how your day impacts your night, and how your night shapes tomorrow. Better context for effort and rest.

  • Recovery insights

    A clearer sense of how you are trending today, so you can adjust training, work, and rest with less guessing.

  • Advanced body metrics

    Notice shifts earlier, and learn what moves your baseline. Clear summaries without turning life into a dashboard.

  • Comfort-first design

    Light, low-profile wear that fits into daily life. The easier it is to wear, the more useful the insight becomes.

  • Routine-ready durability

    Keeps tracking going with fewer interruptions. Keeps tracking going with fewer interruptions.

Technical Specifications

  • Sensors

    A multi-sensor stack that captures the core signals needed for sleep, recovery, and daily trends.

    • Optical PPG LEDs for pulse and related trends
    • Skin temperature sensor for night-to-night variation
    • 3-axis accelerometer for movement and sleep-wake

  • Compatibility

    Built to fit into your current setup with a simple app experience and modern device support.

    • iOS 15+ and Android 10+
    • Apple Health and Google Fit support (optional sync)
    • Supports metric and imperial units of measurement

  • Weight & Dimensions

    Low-profile proportions designed for comfort and consistent wear.

    • Width: 7.9 mm
    • Thickness: 2.9 mm (approx. wedding band profile)
    • Weight: 3.3 to 5.2 g (varies by size)

  • Battery Life

    Designed for multi-day wear so your trends stay consistent without frequent charging.

    • Battery life: 5 to 8 days (typical use)
    • Charge time: 20 to 80 minutes (varies by level)
    • Charging: USB-C powered dock

  • Materials

    Premium, skin-friendly materials built for everyday wear and long-term comfort

    • Titanium shell with a smooth, non-allergenic interior
    • PVD finish options for color durability
    • Water resistance: up to 100 m

  • Connectivity

    Reliable syncing with low power connectivity, plus quiet updates in the background.

    • Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) for efficient syncing
    • Automatic firmware updates via the app
    • Airplane mode support for offline wear

  • Ring One uses optical PPG LEDs, a skin temperature sensor and a 3-axis accelerometer to capture the core signals needed for sleep, recovery and daily trends.

  • Ring One is water-resistant up to 100 meters (~330 feet), meaning that you can wear it while showering, swimming, or partaking in recreational diving (e.g. snorkeling), but we don’t recommend using your Ring One while scuba diving or keeping it submerged underwater for over 12 hours. Chlorine will not damage it.

    Ring One operating temperature ranges from -10–52°C / 14–125°F. You can safely wear your Ring One in the shower, hot tubs, saunas, ice baths, and cryotherapy tanks. However, extended exposure to extreme temperatures (below -20°C / -4°F or above 60°C / 140°F) may lead to battery damage.

What We Track

Track all of you. Not just your steps.

From morning to midnight, every signal your body sends has a home.

  • Step on the scale. Let the trends speak.

    Weight, body fat, muscle mass, BMI. Tracked daily, surfaced as a trend.

  • A quiet read on your heart, every day.

    Blood pressure, resting rate, variability. Tracked at home, surfaced in the app.

  • Glucose, hemoglobin, oxygen. Your blood picture, at home.

    Use Hema One to see what once required a full lab visit.

  • A safe place to check in with yourself.

    Track moods, write privately, notice patterns. Locked behind Face ID by default.

  • Your cycle, tracked within your full health picture.

    Phases, symptoms, and fertility. Connected to how you sleep, move, and feel.

  • Activity and recovery, read as one connected picture.

    Workouts, steps, and deep sleep tracked together because they shape each other.

  • Meals, water, fasting. Nutrition made honest and simple.

    Barcode scanner, manual logging, a recipe library, and a full fasting planner.

Rising claims costs

Chronic disease and reactive care models are pushing claims costs higher each year — without a data layer to intervene earlier, the trend continues.

Limited preventive data

Underwriting still relies on one-time medicals and self-reported forms. The gaps between those snapshots are where the most critical risk goes undetected.

How We Support Insurers

Tailored solutions for every insurance provider

SeeMyHealth gives insurers the tools to move from reactive coverage to proactive, data-driven risk management.

01 — 05Prev/Next

  • Stratify risk with precision

    Continuous biometric data lets insurers build dynamic risk profiles — updated in real time, not just at renewal.

  • Surface preventive insights

    Early warning signals appear in the data long before they become the conditions that drive claims.

  • Monitor chronic conditions

    Continuous monitoring provides the longitudinal data needed to support timely intervention for at-risk policyholders.

  • Power behavioral incentive programs

    Sleep, hydration, and activity data gives insurers the foundation to build wellness programs that prove their impact.

Why distribute SeeMyHealth

Who We’re Looking For

Frequently asked questions

Still have questions? We’re here to help you.

Contact us

  • SeeMyHealth is a health technology brand that makes smart devices designed to fit seamlessly into your everyday life. Our ecosystem — Ring One, Smart Scale, BP Monitor, and Smart Flask — works together to give you a continuous, connected picture of your health, not just a snapshot.

    Think of it less like monitoring yourself, and more like having a quiet companion that pays attention so you don't have to.

  • Each SeeMyHealth device tracks specific health metrics and syncs automatically to the SeeMyHealth app. The app brings everything together — sleep, heart rate, blood pressure, weight, hydration, and more — in one place, so you can see how your habits connect and where small changes make the biggest difference.

    You don't need to check in constantly. SeeMyHealth runs quietly in the background and surfaces what matters when it matters.

  • Not at all. Each SeeMyHealth device works on its own and delivers value right out of the box. That said, using more devices together gives you a fuller, more connected view of your health — patterns become clearer, and insights become more actionable.

    Start with what feels most relevant to your health goals, and build from there.

  • SeeMyHealth devices are designed for general health and wellness tracking and are not intended to diagnose, treat, or replace professional medical advice. That said, many users with chronic conditions such as hypertension, diabetes, or sleep disorders find continuous tracking helpful for staying aware and informed.

    If you have an existing condition, we recommend consulting your healthcare provider before using SeeMyHealth as part of your care routine.

  • Most health devices are built to be noticed — on your wrist, in your ear, on your chest. SeeMyHealth takes a different approach. Our devices are designed to disappear into your daily routine: a ring you forget you're wearing, a scale that takes 10 seconds, a flask that tracks hydration without you thinking about it.

    We're not building a status symbol. We're building tools that make staying healthy feel less like work.

  • Ring One is SeeMyHealth's smart ring — worn on your finger, it tracks your health around the clock without getting in the way of your day. It continuously monitors:

    • Sleep quality and stages
    • Heart rate and resting heart rate
    • Heart rate variability (HRV) — a key indicator of stress and recovery
    • Activity and movement patterns
    • Body temperature trends

    All data syncs automatically to the SeeMyHealth app while you sleep, work, and move through your day.

  • Ring One is designed for up to 7 days of continuous use on a single charge. Actual battery life may vary depending on usage patterns and features enabled. A full charge takes approximately 60–80 minutes using the included charging dock.

    We recommend charging overnight every few days to keep things uninterrupted.

  • Yes. Ring One is water-resistant up to 100 meters, making it safe to wear while washing your hands, swimming, or showering. It's designed to stay on — all day, every day.

  • The Smart Scale goes well beyond the number on the floor. A single weigh-in takes about 10 seconds and gives you:

    • Body weight
    • Body fat percentage
    • Muscle mass
    • Bone density
    • Visceral fat level
    • BMI
    • Body water percentage

    All measurements sync instantly to the SeeMyHealth app, where you can track trends over time rather than fixating on a single reading.

  • The SeeMyHealth BP Monitor is a clinical-grade blood pressure monitor that delivers accurate readings in under 30 seconds. Simply wrap the cuff around your upper arm, press the button, and your systolic, diastolic, and pulse readings are automatically recorded and logged in the app.

    It uses oscillometric measurement technology and meets international accuracy standards. Readings are timestamped and tracked over time so you and your healthcare provider can see trends, not just individual data points.

  • The Smart Flask is a hydration-tracking water bottle that monitors how much you drink throughout the day. Built-in sensors detect liquid intake and sync data to the SeeMyHealth app in real time. You can set daily hydration goals, receive gentle reminders, and review your intake patterns over days and weeks.

    It's available in multiple sizes and is made from BPA-free, food-grade materials. Works with both hot and cold liquids.

  • The SeeMyHealth Glucometer is currently in development and will be joining the ecosystem soon. It will allow for seamless glucose tracking that integrates directly with your existing SeeMyHealth health data — giving a fuller picture for those managing metabolic health.

    Sign up for our newsletter to be the first to know when it launches.

  • All SeeMyHealth devices are managed through the SeeMyHealth app, available on iOS and Android. The app is your central dashboard — it aggregates data from all your devices, surfaces trends and insights, and lets you set goals, reminders, and health targets.

    The app is free to download. Some advanced features and report exports may require a subscription plan.

  • The SeeMyHealth app is compatible with:

    • iOS: iPhone running iOS 14 or later
    • Android: Devices running Android 8.0 or later

    Devices sync via Bluetooth. An internet connection is required for initial setup, cloud backup, and accessing historical data on new devices. Core tracking features continue to function offline.

  • Your health data is encrypted in transit and at rest. SeeMyHealth stores your data on secure, cloud-based servers and complies with applicable data protection regulations including GDPR.

    We do not sell your personal health data to third parties. You have full control over your data — you can export, delete, or revoke access at any time from within the app.

  • Yes. The SeeMyHealth app allows you to generate detailed health reports — including sleep, heart rate, blood pressure, hydration, and body composition trends — that can be downloaded as a PDF and shared directly with your healthcare provider.

    You can also grant view-only access to a healthcare professional through the app's sharing settings, if your provider uses the SeeMyHealth for Business platform.

  • SeeMyHealth devices will continue to sync data to the app over Bluetooth without an internet connection. Your data is stored locally on your phone and will sync to the cloud the next time you're online.

    An internet connection is required for initial account setup, software updates, and accessing data across multiple devices.

  • SeeMyHealth products are available directly at seemyhealth.com and through selected authorized retail and healthcare partners. Purchasing directly from us ensures you receive the full warranty, the latest firmware, and access to our customer support team.

    If you purchased from a retailer, any returns or exchanges must be handled directly with that retailer.

  • Most orders are processed and dispatched within 1–2 business days. Standard delivery typically takes 3–7 business days depending on your location. Estimated delivery times are shown at checkout.

    Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking number. Click the tracking number in the email to follow your delivery directly on the carrier's website.

  • Yes, we ship to selected countries across Asia, North America, Europe, and Australia. Available shipping destinations and fees are shown at checkout based on your delivery address.

    Depending on your country's customs regulations, import duties or taxes may apply upon delivery. These charges are outside of SeeMyHealth's control and are the responsibility of the recipient. We recommend checking your local customs regulations if you're unsure.

  • You can cancel or modify your order as long as it hasn't been dispatched. Contact us as soon as possible at support@seemyhealth.com with your order number.

    Once an order has shipped, modifications are no longer possible. You're welcome to return the item after delivery in accordance with our return policy.

  • We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for any reason, provided the product is in its original condition and packaging. Original shipping fees are non-refundable.

    To initiate a return, email support@seemyhealth.com with your order number. Once we receive and inspect the item, refunds are processed within 3–5 business days to your original payment method.

  • All SeeMyHealth devices are covered by a limited warranty that protects against defects in materials and workmanship under normal use. Coverage periods from date of purchase are as follows:

    • Ring One: 1 year
    • Smart Scale: 1 year
    • BP Monitor: 2 years
    • Smart Flask: 1 year

    The warranty applies to products purchased directly from seemyhealth.com or through an authorized retailer. Proof of purchase is required to submit a claim.

    The following are not covered: accidental damage, physical damage from drops or impact, cosmetic wear and tear, water damage beyond each device's rated resistance, and any modifications not authorized by SeeMyHealth.

  • If your device is eligible for a warranty replacement, we'll provide a unit that's comparable to your original. Replacements may be like-new devices that have been thoroughly cleaned, factory reset, and tested to meet our quality standards.

    Your replacement will be covered for the remainder of your original warranty period, or 90 days from delivery — whichever is longer.

  • If you think your device may have a defect, reach out to us at support@seemyhealth.com. To help us review your case as quickly as possible, please include:

    • Your order number

    • The product model and, for Ring One, the size

    Our team aims to respond within 1 business day and will guide you through the next steps.

  • Yes. Extended protection plans are available for purchase at checkout when buying a new SeeMyHealth device. These plans extend your coverage beyond the standard warranty period and include protection against accidental damage such as drops or physical impact — which is not covered under the standard limited warranty.

    Protection plans can only be added at the time of purchase and cannot be applied retroactively.

  • Ring One is available in sizes 6 through 13. We recommend using our Ring Sizing Guide — available on the product page and as a printable PDF — before placing your order.

    If your ring doesn't fit upon arrival, we offer a free size exchange within 30 days of delivery. Contact our support team with your order number and the size you need, and we'll sort it out.

  • Ring One: Wipe with a soft, lint-free cloth. Avoid abrasive materials or chemical cleaners. Remove from the charging dock when not actively charging to help preserve battery health over time.

    Smart Scale: Wipe the surface with a dry or slightly damp cloth. Do not submerge or expose to excessive moisture. For accurate readings, always place it on a flat, hard surface.

    BP Monitor: Wipe the cuff and unit with a clean, dry cloth after use. Do not wash the cuff with water. Store in the included case when not in use to protect the cuff fabric.

    Smart Flask: The outer shell and lid are dishwasher-safe on the top rack. Hand wash the sensor-equipped base with mild soap and warm water. Do not fully submerge the base.

    Routine cleaning helps maintain accurate readings and extends the lifespan of your devices.

Privacy policy

Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you use our products and services.

  • Data We Collect
  • How We Use Your Data

Your health data is personal — and we treat it that way. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have when you use our Services.

This Policy applies to [SeeMyHealth Legal Entity Name] ("SeeMyHealth," "we," "us," or "our") and covers data collected through our website, mobile application (the "App"), and all hardware products — including The Ring One, Smart Scale, Blood Pressure Monitor, and Smart Flask — and any related services (together, the "Services").
By using our Services, you agree to the practices described here. Questions? Reach us at [privacy@seemyhealth.com].

1. Data We Collect

Data you provide directly:

  • Account details — name, email address, password, date of birth;
  • Health profile — height, weight, biological sex, and any other information you choose to enter;
  • Purchase information — billing and shipping address (payment card data is handled securely by our third-party payment processors; we do not store full card numbers);
  • Communications — messages, feedback, or support requests you send us.

Data collected automatically:

  • Health and biometric data — depending on the Products you use, this may include heart rate, blood pressure readings, body weight and composition, hydration levels, and sleep patterns;
  • Device and usage data — device type, operating system, app version, IP address, and how you interact with the App;
  • Website analytics — browsing behavior, pages visited, and session data collected via cookies and similar technologies. See our Cookie Policy for details.

2. How We Use Your Data

We use the data we collect to:

  • Operate and improve our Products and Services, and generate health insights for you;
  • Process your orders and manage your account;
  • Communicate with you — including order updates, account notices, and (with your consent) marketing;
  • Analyze usage patterns to develop new features and fix issues;
  • Detect and prevent fraud or unauthorized access;
  • Comply with legal obligations in the jurisdictions where we operate.

Important: The data generated by our Products is for personal wellness purposes only and is not clinically validated. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

We may also use aggregated, anonymized data — which cannot identify you — for analytics, research, and business development.

3. Sharing & Disclosure

We do not sell your personal data. We share it only in the following circumstances:

  • Service providers — Trusted vendors (hosting, payments, analytics, customer support) who process data on our behalf and are bound by confidentiality obligations;
  • Third-party integrations — If you choose to connect your data to platforms like Apple Health or Google Health Connect, you are directing us to share your data with those services, which are governed by their own privacy policies;
  • Legal obligations — When required by law, court order, or valid government request. Where legally permitted, we will notify you first;
  • Business transfers — In the event of a merger or acquisition, your data may be transferred as part of that transaction. We will notify you in advance.

4. Data Retention

We keep your data for as long as your account is active or as reasonably necessary to provide our Services, meet legal obligations, and resolve disputes. If you delete your account, your personal data will be deleted or anonymized within [30–90 days], except where retention is required by law. You can request deletion at any time — see Section 5 below.

5. Your Rights & Choices

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or export your personal data, withdraw consent, or object to certain types of processing. We aim to honor these rights regardless of your location.

To make a request, contact us at [privacy@seemyhealth.com] or through the App settings. We will respond within 30 days.

  • Marketing emails — Unsubscribe at any time via the link in any email or through your App preferences.
  • Push notifications — Manage through your device settings.
  • Regional rights — If you are in the EEA or UK, you have rights under GDPR and may lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority. If you are in California, you have rights under the CCPA/CPRA including the right to know, delete, and opt out of any sale of personal information (note: we do not sell personal information).

6. Data Security

We use industry-standard measures — including encryption in transit and at rest, access controls, and regular security reviews — to protect your data. No system is completely secure, but we are committed to notifying you promptly if a breach occurs that is likely to affect your rights or interests.

To help protect your account, use a strong and unique password and enable any additional security features available in the App.

7. Updates to This Policy

We may update this Policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the "Last Updated" date and notify you of material changes via email or in-App notification. Continued use of our Services after any changes takes effect constitutes your acceptance.

Our Services are not directed at children under the age of 16. If you believe we have collected data from a child in error, please contact us and we will delete it promptly.

    How ring sizing works

    Ring PRO uses custom sizes, distinct from standard smart ring and market sizes. A precise fit is essential for accurate data tracking and comfort.

    1. Step 1: Order your Ring One

      Select the 'Free Sizing Kit' option when you order your Ring One. You're purchasing the Ring One, but we’ll send you the sizing kit first at no extra cost.

    2. Step 2: Sizing kit delivery

      Most orders are processed and delivered within 3 days. This kit includes sample ring sizers to help find your ideal fit.

    3. Step 3: Find your perfect fit

      Test the sample rings on your preferred finger. We recommend the index finger for optimal performance and accuracy. If you prefer another finger, the middle and ring fingers are good alternatives.

    4. Step 4: Submit your ring size

      Confirm your size by visiting the link on the sizing kit’s packaging, and we will ship your Ring One to you. Feel free to share your sizing kit with friends and family.

    * Choosing the right Ring One size is essential for comfort and accurate readings. Ring One sizing is unique in comparison to the US Standard.
